title: Welcome to File Island
text: "A Tamer! Just in time. Black Gears have been falling on the island, and every Digimon they strike turns wild. Show me your partners can hold the Forest Clearing."
completeText: "Hm! Not bad at all. The village has almost emptied - maybe you can bring it back to life."

title: A Voice in the Depths
text: "One of our villagers, Tentomon, went into the Forest Depths to study the gears and never came back. Find it."
completeText: Tentomon buzzes out from behind a fallen server: "You found me! I've mapped half the island from in here - let me help you explore the rest."

title: Stronger Together
text: "The deeper forest is full of Champions now. Your partners will need to digivolve to keep up."
completeText: "Look at that! That's the power the Black Gears are trying to take from us."

title: Patrol the Forest
text: "Bzzt - something big crashed into the Forest Heart. The wild ones there are getting worse by the hour. Can you thin them out while I look?"
completeText: "It's a Black Gear - and it hit Leomon, the forest's guardian. He's not himself anymore..."

title: The Guardian Has Gone Wild
text: "Leomon protected this forest for as long as I can remember. Break the gear's hold on him - gently, if you can. Pick a squad with an edge on him: Data types, Water or Plant."
completeText: The Black Gear shatters. Leomon kneels, breathing hard. "I... remember now. Thank you, Tamer. The gears came from past the savanna - I will show you the way."

title: Past the Savanna
text: "The Gear Savanna is overrun. Clear a path across the plains and we'll find where the gears are coming from."
completeText: "There - Primary Village, or what's left of it. Someone is still there."

title: The Raided Village
text: "They came through the canyon and smashed the cradles! The eggs - all the babies' eggs - scattered everywhere. Help me drive the raiders out of Gear Canyon!"
completeText: "The canyon's quiet. Now... the eggs. Please."

title: The Lost Eggs
text: "Every egg you find and hatch is a baby home safe. Raise them - they're the village's future. I'll build new cradles for you when you're done."
completeText: "You brought them home. I'm coming with you - I'll build your hatchery more cradles, as many as you need."

title: Stampede
text: "A Monochromon with a gear in its back is leading the herd - that's who flattened the village. Stop it. Vaccines, Water or Earth hit it hardest."
completeText: The herd scatters as the gear breaks. Monochromon lies down in the dust, calm at last.

title: Smoke on the Mountain
text: "Please help! The mountain's fire spirit has gone mad - fire rains down on our village every night! Clear the foothills so we can run!"
completeText: "Thank you, thank you! But it's still up there, burning..."

title: Cool Heads
text: "Our well is dry and the fires keep coming. If you have Water Digimon, they could keep the flames off the village."
completeText: "The fires hiss out as soon as they land! We're safe down here now."

title: The Fire Spirit
text: "Meramon lives in the crater. It used to keep us warm... there's a Black Gear in it, we saw it glowing! Vaccines, Water or Earth will cool it down."
completeText: Meramon's flames shrink back to a warm glow. The whole village cheers - "Come live with us! We'll open an egg stall - we find the strangest eggs on this mountain!"

title: The Endless Blizzard
text: "Brrr... this blizzard hasn't stopped in weeks. Everyone's lost in the snow. Help me find a way through the snowfield?"
completeText: "I can see the sky for the first time in days! But look up there - something is circling in the storm."

title: Warm Bodies
text: "The little ones on the shore are freezing. Fire Digimon could keep them warm while we wait out the storm."
completeText: "They're toasty! Here - I found this in the ice. It'll keep your squad going longer."

title: The White Horse
text: "It's Unimon - a gear caught it, and the blizzard follows wherever it flies. It's a holy beast, so Data types and Dark Digimon have the edge."
completeText: Unimon lands in the snow and the storm finally breaks. Freezeland glitters in the sun - and deep caves open up below the ice.

title: The Self-Building Factory
text: "The factory won't stop building! Machines everywhere, and none of them listen. Please, break through the gates!"
completeText: "The gates are open... Andromon, our master, went into the core to shut it down. He never came out."

title: Down the Drain
text: "The only other way into the core is through the sewers. They're... full of Numemon. Sorry."
completeText: "You made it through! The core is just ahead. Be careful - Andromon is an Ultimate."

title: Spare Parts
text: "If I had an Attack Chip I could patch the factory's controls from out here. Expeditions turn them up sometimes."
completeText: "Click, whirr - got it! The assembly lines are slowing down. Here, take these."

title: The Ultimate Wall
text: "Andromon is fused to the core by a Black Gear. He's an Ultimate - stronger than anything you've faced. Bring your best four, with Data types and Fire, and use every chip you've got."
completeText: The core powers down. Andromon steps free. "My systems... are my own again. I owe you, Tamer. Let me open a shop in your village - I can build almost anything."

title: Whamon Can't Surface
text: A deep voice rumbles under the water: "Something has taken my lake... I cannot rise. Clear the shallows, little Tamer, and I will tell you more."
completeText: "It is Seadramon. A gear drove it mad, and it coils in the deep water where I cannot reach."

title: Counter-Current
text: "Seadramon fears the lightning of the storms. Bring Electric Digimon - they will turn the water against it."
completeText: "Good. With those, you can face it."

title: Lord of the Lake
text: "Free Seadramon, and the lake is ours again. Vaccines, Plant or Electric will serve you best."
completeText: Whamon rises at last, enormous and gentle. "I have swum every sea of this world. When you are ready to leave this island, I will carry you across."

title: The Eight Symbols
text: "The Hall of Symbols has eight carvings that glow when a Tamer is near! But the guardians won't let anyone in anymore."
completeText: The carvings flicker as you pass - eight shapes, each a different crest. "Centarumon would know what they mean... but it's the one keeping us out."

title: The Ruins' Guardian
text: "Centarumon has guarded the sanctum forever - but now it attacks everyone. There's a gear on its arm! Vaccines and Fire Digimon, quickly!"
completeText: Centarumon lowers its arm. "The symbols are Crests - the power that lets Digimon grow past their limits. They were scattered across the sea long ago. I will read them for you."

title: A Worthy Team
text: "The Crests answer only to Tamers whose partners have grown strong. Show me five Champions standing together."
completeText: "Yes. You are the one the carvings spoke of."

title: The Source of the Gears
text: "Every gear we broke came from this mountain. Whoever is behind this waits at the top. Clear the way up."
completeText: "Ogremon blocks the pass. He serves the one at the peak - I'd know that club anywhere."

title: Ogremon's Pass
text: "Ogremon and I have fought a hundred times. He is strong but reckless - Vaccines and Light will break through him."
completeText: Ogremon staggers back into the rocks. "This isn't over, Leomon!" - and runs. The way to the peak is open.

title: The Dark Lord of File Island
text: "Devimon. He has been making the gears all along, to bend the whole island to his will. This is what everything has led to - Vaccines and Light, your strongest four, every chip you have."
completeText: Devimon falls. "You think... this is the end? My master waits across the sea... the network..." The gears stop falling. Jijimon hands you a set of empty Tags: "For the Crests. Whamon will take you across when you are ready."
